idiom-31-q31.truthCondition: Marcus and Theo share the main goal but argue angrily about the method of reaching it.
idiom-31-q31.correctReason: 正確句保留兩人對目標有共識、卻為達成方法激烈爭吵的對比。

foils.text: Although Marcus and Theo disagree on the main goal, they fight like cat and dog about how to reach it.
foils.reason: 「disagree on the main goal」改掉了原題說兩人同意主要目標的事實。

foils.text: Although Marcus and Theo agree on the main goal, they fight like cat and dog about whether to pursue it.
foils.reason: 「whether to pursue it」把爭議改成要不要追求目標；原題的分歧在達成方法。

foils.text: Marcus and Theo agree on the main goal and calmly settle how to reach it together.
foils.reason: 「calmly settle」說兩人和平解決方法分歧，與原題的激烈爭吵相反。

idiom-31-q32.truthCondition: Neither cousin will change their mind; they argue angrily every time they plan together.
idiom-31-q32.correctReason: 「Because neither cousin ...」交代雙方不願讓步這個原因；「whenever」保留每次訂計劃都會吵。

foils.text: Because both cousins readily change their minds, they fight like cat and dog whenever they make plans together.
foils.reason: 「readily change their minds」與原題說兩人都不肯改變想法相反。

foils.text: Because neither cousin changes their mind, they fight like cat and dog only when they plan holidays together.
foils.reason: 「only ... holidays」把每次一起訂計劃縮成只限旅行計劃。

foils.text: Neither cousin changes their mind, but they usually make plans together without arguing.
foils.reason: 「without arguing」否定了原題的每次一起訂計劃便激烈爭吵。

idiom-31-q33.truthCondition: Lily and Zoe initially worked quietly, then argued fiercely over every task by the week's end.
idiom-31-q33.correctReason: 正確句保留先安靜合作、到星期末卻為每項工作激烈爭吵的轉變。

foils.text: At first, Lily and Zoe fought like cat and dog; by the end of the week, they worked quietly.
foils.reason: 這句把起初安靜、後來爭吵的時間線倒轉。

foils.text: At first, Lily and Zoe worked quietly; by the end of the week, they fought like cat and dog over one task.
foils.reason: 「one task」把為每項工作爭吵改成只為一項工作爭吵。

foils.text: At first, Lily and Zoe worked quietly; by the end of the week, they still worked without arguing.
foils.reason: 「still worked without arguing」抹去了星期末已開始的激烈爭吵。

idiom-31-q34.truthCondition: Adam and Dylan argued fiercely for several lessons; the teacher then moved them to different groups.
idiom-31-q34.correctReason: 正確句保留連續幾堂課的爭吵先於老師把兩人調往不同小組。

foils.text: The teacher moved Adam and Dylan to different groups before they began fighting like cat and dog.
foils.reason: 「before」把調組放在爭吵之前；原題說老師在連續幾堂課爭吵後才調組。

foils.text: The teacher moved Adam and Dylan to the same group after they had fought like cat and dog for several lessons.
foils.reason: 「the same group」把分到不同小組改成調往同一小組。

foils.text: The teacher moved Adam and Dylan after they had worked peacefully together for several lessons.
foils.reason: 「worked peacefully」把調組原因由激烈爭吵改成和平合作。

idiom-31-q35.truthCondition: Rachel warned that her brothers would argue angrily if they were allowed to choose the music.
idiom-31-q35.correctReason: 正確句保留瑞秋的警告，以及「讓兄弟選音樂」便會激烈爭吵的條件。

foils.text: Rachel warned us that her brothers would fight like cat and dog if we chose the music for them.
foils.reason: 「we chose the music for them」把爭吵條件由兄弟自行選音樂改成由我們代選。

foils.text: Rachel warned us that her brothers might fight like cat and dog if we let them choose the music.
foils.reason: 「might」把瑞秋明確預告會爭吵改成只說可能爭吵。

foils.text: Rachel assured us that her brothers would agree calmly if we let them choose the music.
foils.reason: 「agree calmly」把瑞秋的爭吵警告改成和平選曲的保證。
